response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), with_name AS (SELECT raceId, name, avg_points, result_count, AVG(avg_points) OVER (PARTITION BY name) AS name_avg FROM per_race) SELECT raceId, name, avg_points, result_count, avg_points * 1.0 / NULLIF(name_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM with_name ORDER BY (avg_points * 1.0 / NULLIF(name_avg, 0)) IS NULL, ratio DESC, raceId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Higher side" of the 1.0 dividing line means constructorResults.points > 1.0 strictly, so results of exactly 1.0 are excluded.
The race-name average is the unweighted mean of per-race averages, taken only over races that have at least one kept result. Ties in ratio are broken by raceId.

alternatives.interpretation: The higher side includes the dividing line itself (points >= 1.0).
